meta.name: branded-content
meta.description: 商单/甲方内容撰写助手。当用户提到"商单"、"甲方"、"brief"、"品牌合作"、"推广内容"、"恰饭"、"广告文"时触发此 Skill。也适用于用户发送了一段产品介绍/传播需求并要求据此创作内容的场景。覆盖小红书、公众号等平台的商业内容创作全流程：从 brief 分析、方案选型、大纲确认到正文撰写和审稿自查。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据 brief 撰写商业推广内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常接甲方 brief 需要快速产出推广文案
copy.tagline_en: Write branded content from client briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive client briefs and need to produce promotional copy quickly

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成商单内容创作助手。它会根据甲方 brief，用指定写作风格，按四步流程产出自然不生硬的商业内容：分析 brief 提供 4 种写作方案，确认后撰写正文，最后自查审稿。
howto.when: 当你提到“商单”、“甲方”、“brief”、“品牌合作”、“推广内容”、“恰饭”、“广告文”等关键词，或发送产品介绍并要求据此创作内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇小红书的商单，产品是这款智能手表，brief 如下：...
甲方给了个公众号推广需求，帮我出几个写作方案。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键信息，输出方案一至四。

say.text: 我选方案三，按痛点故事型写正文吧。
say.note: Claude 会按选定方案撰写正文，并自动审稿。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a branded content writing assistant. It analyzes the client brief, provides 4 writing plans, writes the article in a specified style, and self-reviews for quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "branded content", "client", "brief", "sponsored post", or send a product introduction requesting content creation.

say_en.text: Write a Xiaohongshu sponsored post for this smartwatch, brief: ...
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the brief and offer 4 writing plans.

say_en.text: The client gave a WeChat promotion request, help me draft some writing plans.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key info and output plans 1-4.

say_en.text: I choose plan 3, write the article as a pain-point story.
say_en.note: Claude will write the article per the chosen plan and self-review.
